closure.exact_boundary: Every finite binary, self or tracer diffusion record with complete constituent identities, held phase, exact conditions, counted adjacent cells, transitions and ticks. External testing preserves every direct diffusion point from three complete NIST sources and every non-diffusion companion dataset as excluded provenance.
